WITH ss_1998 AS (
    SELECT c_customer_id, SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) year_total
    FROM customer
    JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 1998 AND sale_type = 's'
    GROUP BY c_customer_id
),
ss_1999 AS (
    SELECT c_customer_id, SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) year_total
    FROM customer
    JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 1999 AND sale_type = 's'
    GROUP BY c_customer_id
),
ws_1998 AS (
    SELECT c_customer_id, SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) year_total
    FROM customer
    JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 1998 AND sale_type = 'w'
    GROUP BY c_customer_id
),
ws_1999 AS (
    SELECT c_customer_id, SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) year_total
    FROM customer
    JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 1999 AND sale_type = 'w'
    GROUP BY c_customer_id
)
SELECT t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
FROM ss_1998 t_s_firstyear
LEFT JOIN ss_1999 t_s_secyear ON t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id
LEFT JOIN ws_1998 t_w_firstyear ON t_w_firstyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id
LEFT JOIN ws_1999 t_w_secyear ON t_w_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id
WHERE t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0 AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0
AND (t_w_secyear.year_total / GREATEST(t_w_firstyear.year_total, 1)) >
    (t_s_secyear.year_total / GREATEST(t_s_firstyear.year_total, 1))
ORDER BY t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
